newsitem.title: USA: U.S. woman charged in fire death of disabled child.
newsitem.headline: U.S. woman charged in fire death of disabled child.

text.p: A woman was charged with murder and arson Thursday in the death of her 2-year-old disabled daughter.

Police said Kelly Ritt first told them her daughter kicked a blanket onto a space heater, sparking the March 25 fire from which Ritt and three other children escaped. The toddler, who was deaf and had a feeding tube in her stomach because of congenital health problems, died in the fire.
Hastings Police Chief Nick Wasylik told reporters Thursday investigators received a number of calls questioning Ritt's original story.
"There were no specifics in the calls, they didn't tell us to go and search for something. They were just statements that we should continue our investigation," he said.
According to court papers released Thursday Ritt, told police she saw the blanket on the space heater but ignored it. It was not clear if the child had kicked the item from her bed.
Ritt, whose husband was not at home the night of the fire, was convicted a year ago of embezzling $556,000 from a company where she worked as a bookkeeper.
